title: Bundle of Holding

agent.notes: Bundle of Holding sells time-limited RPG bundles, not individual discounted items. The front page redirects to the current bundle, and /presents lists the bundles. I tested product_link on /presents and it found 5 bundles (Blue Fox Cthulhu, Monster Hunters, Cohors Cthulhu, The Black Ballad, Yellow King RPG). price_now matched US$17.95 on BlueFox and US$19.95 on DeathInSpace. The normal price is shown as the total retail value in bold text in the overview, e.g. $87 for BlueFox and $80 for DeathInSpace, and it is not struck through. My price_was selector also matches the bundle title and other bold text, so code has to pick the entry that starts with a dollar sign. The `:nth-of-type(2)` variant and the `p:last-of-type > strong:last-of-type` variant did not give the price. I found no sale end date in the text of the pages I opened. I saw no instructions aimed at AI on any page.
